objective_convention: Q = certified gross_operational_cost: gross operational cost, contracted interface settlement excluded; one market scenario (deviation settlement and commitment premium identically 0); terminal salvage 0 on both rows

constants.sources: shared_energy_storage.py defaults; definitions.py; asserted in the capture checklist

day_selection.rule: declared (STEP7 plan section 7): the (year, day) block with the largest value contribution Q(0) - Q(x) in the certified decomposition; labelled an illustrative day, not a typical-day estimate; horizon totals remain representative-day-weighted
day_selection.convention: Q = certified gross_operational_cost, contracted interface settlement excluded; block values block-weighted (year count x day count x discount annualisation, _get_admm_block_weight); value contribution = Q_row1(x = 0) - Q_row2(x), EUR; positive = cheaper with storage
day_selection.per_block_Q_definition: sum over ['generation_cost', 'flexibility_cost_internal', 'load_curtailment_cost', 'res_curtailment_penalty', 'ess_usage_cost', 'detector_penalty_total'] of component_levels_terminal blocks.<b>.weighted, summed over TSO + DSO 5/7/9 of the (year, day)

resolution.note: bar = sum over both rows of the per-(year, day) block range over each row's certification window (recourse_blocks_all.jsonl); a local, stopping-slack measure only (CLAUDE.md refinement of 2026-09-13)

panel_a_declared_day.label: illustrative day (not a typical-day estimate)
panel_a_declared_day.units: MW, MVAr, MWh (1 h periods); pnet = pch - pdch, positive = charging (sess_pnet_rule)
panel_a_declared_day.soc_DERIVED_label: DERIVED, not model variables: SoC recursion (eff_ch 0.97, eff_dch 0.96, start 0.5 E^Av record) from the ESSO pch / pdch, and from the consensus z net power split as pch = max(pnet, 0), pdch = max(-pnet, 0); the ESSO model has no intra-day SoC

panel_b_per_block_change_vs_x0.convention: change = row 2 (x) minus row 1 (x = 0), EUR; "weighted" = block-weighted and discounted (the Q decomposition), "unweighted" = one representative day (scenario-probability-weighted only); a negative change is a saving
panel_b_per_block_change_vs_x0.dn_flexibility_activation_measure: DSO flexibility_cost_internal (EUR) -- the activation COST; the activation volume (MWh) of row 1 is carried by no committed record
panel_b_per_block_change_vs_x0.secondary_label: secondary_interface_delta_p_tn_side: sum over the 24 hours of the TN-side signed interface reparametrisation interface_delta_p (MW x 1 h) per DN, from the committed interface_settlement_detail_s31c.json -- an INTERFACE quantity, not the DN-internal activation volume; unweighted (one day)

panel_c_e_available.convention: E^Av = published_available_capacity_terminal.e_available (END-of-block SoH x E_rated; available_energy_soh_point "end"); floor = minimum_soh x E_rated = 0.70 x E_rated

esso_side.index_mapping: capture y -> SRP1.json Years order, d -> Days order, p -> period (validated by the pnet match)
esso_side.efc_formula: avg_ch_dch(y) = sum_d (num_days_d / 365) sum_p (0.97 pch + pdch / 0.96) x 1 h (shared_energy_storage_data, energy_storage_charging_discharging); EFC/day = avg / (2 E_rated)

pickle_extraction.tso_index_mapping: SRP1.json DistributionNetworks order (planning_problem.distribution_networks insertion order, _add_shared_energy_storage_to_transmission_network); validated for node 7 by the stride match; nodes 5/9 carry zero capacity (immaterial)

e_av_pickle_vs_record.note: network copies hold the E^Av that the ESSO published BEFORE the cycle-k* network solves (shared_resources_planning.get_updated_capacities at the end of cycle k*-1); the record holds the terminal ESSO value (hypothesis for any difference, not verified)
